ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher, and flag the driver's account for review of the "I'm Here" / waiting-fee button abuse (tapped 601 m from the pickup point, never entered the 200 m arrival radius).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup point is contradicted by the system records: GPS shows a closest approach of 545 m [F1] and 601 m at the time of the tap [F5], and the platform never logged him at the pickup point [F4]. System records (gps/timeline) override statements.
Driver's chat claim 'Waited more than 3 min' is not a wait at the pickup point — the 3 min 30 s stationary period [F2] occurred 600 m away, so it cannot support NS-1 (iii).
